title: 『オペレーション：ダンスフィーバー』

text_block_list.text: On our way home from a day out, we see a huge crowd gathered in front of an arcade.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Cause of congestion—AR Dance Game. Eighty-five percent of students in class bring it up in conversation.
choice_data_list: Want to give it a try?
Want to give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes, but it's a two-player competitive game. I can see that you're tired from work, Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Based on these factors, I believe we should try at a later—
Beep, beep, beep! Anomaly detected on the class representative radar! You two must be in some kind of trouble!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Approaching target identified. Is something the matter, Bakushin O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: As an exemplary class representative, it goes without saying that I'm even on the lookout for students in need after school!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: And so, I heard the cry from deep in your heart and came running!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It was shouting, "Oh, how I want someone to play the dance game with me!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A voice from my heart… That is incorrect. No brain waves have been transmitted.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, I've identified a "stroke of luck." A worthy opponent has been acquired.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Proceeding to song selection. Your orders, Master?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Something cool… My classmates have used this word in contexts such as "finishing a song on max difficulty would be so cool."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I propose that we set the difficulty level to the highest.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: As an honor student, it is my mission never to shy away from a challenge! I accept your request!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Arrived at AR area. Commencing dance battle.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… Haaah, haaah…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ho, ho, not bad! But I'm not about to lo—WHAT?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: GRRR! This machine just can't keep up with my incredible speed! It must be a design flaw!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The results will remain unknown until the end. Pressing score display button.
Click… Beep… Bzzzt!

text_block_list.name: Employee
text_block_list.text: Aieee! Why's there smoke coming out of the machine?! Wait… the data's getting erased too?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Visual confirmation of equipment failure. Score erasure confirmed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Mission failed. The machine broke down because I touched it… My sincere apologies, Master.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That's right! It's about feeling, spirit, and guts! In other words… I definitely got a perfect score!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: If it's about feeling, then…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master, how did my dance make you feel?
choice_data_list: I thought it was the coolest thing ever!
I thought it was the coolest thing ever!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The coolest thing ever…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wonderful! My duty as class representative has been fulfilled!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Heh… Indeed. Mission complete.
Thus, the heated dance battle ends with both participants as winners!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood. I will select an exciting song.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm the class favorite! If you want something exciting, look no further! I'll take you on!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Arrived at AR area. Commencing dance battle.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wow, those two are really into it! Seeing them makes me want to dance, too!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Indoor temperature rising. More people than anticipated have gathered.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yeeeaah! We're heating up now! I'm feeling it!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master's words of encouragement received.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Now, here comes the chorus! Come on, Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood. Setting engines to maximum power!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… Game complete. I expended all my energy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That was so amazing! We were on fire! You get my ultimate seal of approval!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Did you like it, Master?
choice_data_list: It got me really fired up!
It got me really fired up!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. It was all thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Your cheers lifted my mood and boosted my performance.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: You could even say that I was "into it." This moment has been recorded in my memory logs.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Well, I love the sound of that! Looks like my work here as class representative is finished!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Heh… Indeed. Mission complete.
Thus, the heated dance battle ends with both participants feeling exhilarated!
